description: See your ProjectManager projects and tasks right inside ChatGPT. Ask what's due, find your next priority, or spot risks. Turn a plan you've been discussing into a realistic ProjectManager schedule with task hierarchy, dates, priorities and assignees. Use ChatGPT to analyze projects and bottlenecks, if you find issues you can change task status and priority on the fly, without leaving the chat.

defaultPrompt: Which tasks should I focus on this week?
Which projects need my attention right now?
Help me plan a new project from scratch.
